# S KHAN Heavy & Electric Vehicle Roadways Command Center — V1.4

V1.4 focuses on the data/security architecture layer: local structured records, role-aware screens, document/KYC placeholders, audit events, and an admin data overview.

This is still a prototype. Real authentication, backend database, encrypted storage, payment gateway, maps/GPS, cloud media, notifications, production tax configuration and legal policies must be integrated before live deployment.
